articles.title: Confidence and interest in buy-to-let has increased –  broker

Her comments come as many companies report an increase in landlords leaving the market.
articles.ai_summary:

articles.title: Four in five landlords unprepared for Renters’ Right Act

- **Investment Hesitation:** 75% of landlords are deterred from expanding their portfolios, and 49% plan to sell or cut back on their investments within the next two months.
